LuaFunction.Name: _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireOrderedVertices()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns an ordered table containing the vertices for a contact wire's 3D geometry.
LuaFunction.Signature: Table of {Double X, Double Y} _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireOrderedVertices(ObjectReference contactWire)
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireOrderedVertices(cow) cow = cow or this
function getVertex(obj) return obj.RcType == rctype_Cantilever and NOBN_ocs_getWireClampPoint3D(obj) or getPoint3D(obj) end
local consolesOnOcsPole = table.select(cow:getRelatedObjects(rel_ContactWireOrMidpointAnchoringLineOrHvConductor_IsTensionedBy_Wtb), function (x) return table.firstOrNil(x:getRelatedObjects(rel_GuyWireOrSpannerOrWtb_IsAttachedTo_ConsoleOnOcsPole)) end) local cantilevers = table.select(cow:getRelatedObjects(rel_ContactWire_IsHeldBy_Cantilever)) local objectsAtVertices = table.select(getUnionOfCollections({consolesOnOcsPole, cantilevers}))
--Make table of vertices {Double X, Double Y} local vertices = {} for _, v in pairs(objectsAtVertices) do table.insert(vertices, getVertex(v)) end
--Find center of gravity of all vertices local g = getPoint3D(0,0) for _, v in pairs(vertices) do g = getVectorSum(g, v) end g = getVectorScalarProduct(1/#vertices, g)
--Find the vertex f which is the most distant from the center of gravity (largest squared 2D distance) local maxDist = -1 local f for _, v in pairs(vertices) do local d = (v.X - g.X)^2 + (v.Y - g.Y)^2 if d > maxDist then maxDist = d f = v end end
--Let gf be the 2D vector from g to f, to be used as a yardstick to order all vertices gf = getPoint3D(f.X - g.X, f.Y - g.Y)
--Sort vertices a, b according to XY plane dot products ga.gf vs gb.gf - the vertices should be more or less on a fairly straight line table.sort(vertices, function (a, b) ga = getPoint3D(a.X - g.X, a.Y - g.Y) gb = getPoint3D(b.X - g.X, b.Y - g.Y) local gagf = getVectorDotProduct(ga, gf) local gbgf = getVectorDotProduct(gb, gf) return gagf > gbgf end) return vertices end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireHorizontalGeometrySegments()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns an ordered sequence of horizontal segments for use in the contact wire's RcAlignment.HorizontalGeometry.Segments property.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireHorizontalGeometrySegments(cow) cow = cow or this local lib1 = includeLuaFile("Lua\\Functions\\lib1.lua") local vertices = _JBTEH_KTL_getContactWireOrderedVertices(cow) local segments = {} for i = 2, #vertices do table.insert(segments, lib1.createHorizontalGeometryStraightSegment(vertices[i-1], vertices[i])) end return segments end

LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTEH_KTL_Color() if Wire2dColor == "Black" then return 7 --Displays as white elseif Wire2dColor == "Blue" then return "30,144,255" elseif Wire2dColor == "Purple" then return "148,0,211" elseif Wire2dColor == "Red" then return "252,10,28" elseif Wire2dColor == "Brown" then return "139,69,19" elseif Wire2dColor == "Orange" then return "255,140,0" elseif Wire2dColor == "Green" then return "50,205,50" elseif Wire2dColor == "Yellow" then return 2 else return 7 --white end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTEH_BAR_code()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the code for the OCS guywire, inherited from its OCS pole's force relaying console.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTEH_BAR_code() local t --TODO: Take into consideration more than one force relaying console to same OCS pole, add a unique suffix number to the code for all the guywires present. local sAnp = rel_GuyWireOrSpannerOrWtb_IsAttachedTo_ConsoleOnOcsPole local rAnp, nAnp = getRelatedObjects(sAnp) if nAnp == 0 then return _unfinished,"UNFINISHED - Relate to its force relaying console on OCS pole." else local anp = rAnp[0]
if anp.Variant == "Bracket on pole for tension balancer and guy wire" then --guywire to counteract the WTB's forces on OCS pole: t = "-B"
elseif anp.Variant == "Bracket on pole for tension balancer" then return _error,"ERROR - Guywire is not compatible with a bracket for tension balancer only (no guywire expected)."
else return _error,"ERROR - Unrecognized bracket Variant '"..anp.Variant.."'." end
local sPol = rel_ConsoleOnOcsPole_IsInstalledOn_OcsPole local rPol, nPol = getRelatedObjects(sPol, rAnp[0]) if nPol == 0 then return _unfinished,"UNFINISHED - The related force relaying console has no relation to a its OCS pole, cannot deduce guywire's code." else return rPol[0].code..t end end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTEH_BAR_chkRelations()
LuaFunction.Description: A guywire footplate shall relate to a guywire alignment and to its foundation.
LuaFunction.Formula:
function _JBTEH_BAR_chkRelations() local _rAnp, nAnp = getRelatedObjects(rel_GuyWireOrSpannerOrWtb_IsAttachedTo_ConsoleOnOcsPole) local _rAnt, nAnt = getRelatedObjects(rel_GuyWireOrSpannerOrWtb_IsAnchoredBy_TunnelFootplate) local _rAng, nAng = getRelatedObjects(rel_GuyWire_IsAnchoredBy_GuywireFootplate)
if (nAnp + nAnt) == 1 and nAng == 1 then return _ok,"OK - Guywire alignment is related to a force relaying console on OCS pole or to a tunnel wall anchor, and to its footplate."
elseif (nAnp + nAnt) == 0 then return _unfinished,"UNFINISHED - Guywire alignment shall relate to a force relaying console on an OCS pole (JBTEH_KPM) or on a tunnel wall/ceiling (JBTEH_TUF)."
else return _unfinished,"UNFINISHED - Guywire alignment shall relate to its footplate." end end

LuaFunction.Name: _JBTEH_BAR_Offset3DZ()
LuaFunction.Description: Returns the Z offset for a guywire object, assuming the alignment has no (or zero) vertical profile. The start point is fetched from the guywire's force relaying console on its OCS pole. The end point is fetched from the guy wire's anchoring to a guywire footplate.
LuaFunction.Formula: function _JBTEH_BAR_Offset3DZ() --2025-10-08 CLFEY New code, handles that the guywire may be drawn from anchor to pole (customer request) local atp = getRelatedObjects(rel_OcsPole_IsInstallationTargetFor_ConsoleOnOcsPole)[0] local gwf = getRelatedObjects(rel_GuyWire_IsAnchoredBy_GuywireFootplate)[0] local L = RcAlignment.HorizontalGeometry.Length local z0, z1, dZ local d = RC__getDistance2D(getPoint3D(gwf), RcAlignment.HorizontalGeometry.StartPoint) if d < 1.0 then --The guywire has probably been drawn from guywire-footplate to force relaying console on OCS pole z0 = gwf.geoCoord.Z z1 = atp.GeoCoord.Z else --The guywire has probably been drawn from force relaying console on pole to guywire-footplate z0 = atp.GeoCoord.Z z1 = gwf.geoCoord.Z end dZ = z1 - z0 return z0 + _position.Pos * (dZ/L) end
